name: fireslide
description: Create, edit, import image assets, and export Fireslide presentations through the hosted Fireslide MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Fireslide connects Codex to the hosted Fireslide MCP server for style-aware presentation authoring, existing-deck revisions, user-provided image asset import, intentional media and news research, deck preview metadata, editor handoff, and PPTX export from Fireslide.
defaultPrompt: Create a Fireslide deck from this brief.
Turn these notes into a presentation.
